summary: A fast-spoken, flat-animation explainer that opens mid-sentence with no cold-open hook, relying entirely on dense narration over simple rotating-cog graphics and persistent on-screen text to teach gear ratios in under a minute. Pacing is driven almost entirely by speech rate rather than cuts, with shot lengths far longer and cut rate far lower than typical explainers, while vocabulary-dense voiceover runs at a corpus-topping wpm throughout.
